_comment: REA batch 04: cases whose X_ITE world is a stand-in reference. X_ITE 16.5.0 runs `world` from cases.txt; Rust runs rs_world, and each [old, new] of subs is applied to the Rust scene text before the comparison. annotation-layer: the dormant X_ITE AnnotationLayer cannot initialize (X3DLayerNode.initialize reads _hidden, _visible, _children, which it does not define; evidence/boundary/annotation-layer-x_ite-probe.json), so an empty Layer stands in. Only the node name, its own fields, the component statement and the isPickable/pickable field name are excused. icon-annotation: the dormant X_ITE IconAnnotation cannot initialize either (X3DUrlObject.initialize reads _load, which it does not define); GeoMetadata, whose requestImmediateLoad is also empty, stands in. Only the node name and the component statement are excused.
